messages.author: ccbc0372916dcfdd
messages.subject: stan compile error
parts:
Hi Guys,

Does anybody ran into this error?
I have tried to compile PyStan /w Stan 2.9.0 release on standard ubuntu 14.04 (boost 1.54) and 15.04 (boost 1.58) too and I ran into this error 

/usr/include/boost/spirit/home/phoenix/core/detail/actor.hpp:54:5: note:   template argument deduction/substitution failed:
In file included from /usr/include/boost/spirit/home/qi/action/action.hpp:21:0,
                 from /usr/include/boost/spirit/home/qi/action.hpp:14,
                 from /usr/include/boost/spirit/home/qi.hpp:14,
                 from /usr/include/boost/spirit/include/qi.hpp:16,
                 from pystan/stan/src/stan/lang/grammars/expression_grammar_def.hpp:15,
                 from pystan/stan/src/stan/lang/grammars/expression_grammar_inst.cpp:1:
/usr/include/boost/spirit/home/support/action_dispatch.hpp:178:39: note:   candidate expects 10 arguments, 3 provided
             f(attr_wrap, context, pass);

on both platforms and cannot get over it.
I made the compilation with 
sudo python setup.py install

Does anybody know how to get over it?

Thanks,
Lev
